title: Confidant has been installed
subtitle: Your private second brain is set up on this Mac. Here is what it does and how to use it.

stats.stillFilling: Still filling in your older history

whatItIs.heading: What it is
whatItIs.body: Confidant is a private second brain built from your own working history: messages, meetings, email and notes, organized into a plain folder of notes on this Mac. Six agents read it on a schedule and tell you what needs your attention, so you stop having to remember everything yourself.

howItWorks.heading: How it works
howItWorks.body: Your connected sources feed a private folder of notes on this Mac. The six agents above read that folder on their own schedule and write back to it: briefs, radar, and updated notes on people, projects and commitments.

howToUse.heading: How to use it
howToUse.obsidian: Open the vault in Obsidian to read and search everything it knows: {link}
howToUse.briefs: Your morning brief and weekly review land in the {folder} folder as plain notes.
howToUse.scheduled: Every agent run shows up in the Scheduled view inside the ChatGPT app, so you can see what ran and when.
howToUse.ask: Open this vault as a project in Codex and just ask. A few things people ask:
examples: Prep me for my 10:30 with Mike
What did I promise people this week?

connected.heading: What is connected
connected.backfilling: The install sorted your most recent 60 days. The rest of your history keeps filling in on its own, oldest first, roughly every 3 hours.

privacy.heading: Privacy
privacy.neverSeesEmpty: You have not excluded anything specific yet. Ask Codex to update your setup any time to add banking, health, family chats, or anyone else you want left out.
privacy.whereItLivesBody: Your notes live in a plain folder on this Mac, at {vault}. To do its work, Codex sends the context it needs to OpenAI's models through your own ChatGPT account. You control that account's own data settings from inside ChatGPT.
privacy.controlBody: Every source stays read-only: Confidant never writes back to Gmail, Slack, or anywhere else it reads from. You can disconnect a source, add an exclusion, or change what it never sees at any time by asking Codex to update your setup.

items.q: A brief did not show up
items.a: Agents only run while this Mac is awake and the ChatGPT app is open. Check the Scheduled view in the ChatGPT app for the run and what it says.
Open System Settings, then Privacy & Security, then Full Disk Access, and turn ChatGPT back on. Relaunch ChatGPT, then tell Codex "continue setting up my second brain".
Reconnect it from the ChatGPT app's connector settings, then tell Codex "continue setting up my second brain".
Ask Codex to run confidant keys set for that source again.
Open the Scheduled view inside the ChatGPT app: you can pause, edit, or delete any of the six agents there directly.
Tell Codex "continue setting up my second brain" in this vault's project. It resumes exactly where it left off.

items.q: You want to stop using Confidant
items.a: Delete the scheduled tasks for this vault from the Scheduled view, then delete the vault folder. Nothing else on your Mac depends on it.
